domain_name: NY State & Federal Appellate / Motion Drafting

required_criteria.name: Source-Grounded Record Anchoring
required_criteria.description: Every factual assertion must map directly to a specific exhibit, affidavit, or transcript line provided in the practitioner's input packet.

required_criteria.name: Explicit Standard of Review
required_criteria.description: The argument section must explicitly state and apply the governing procedural standard (e.g., CPLR 3212 summary judgment, FRCP 12(b)(6), or appellate abuse-of-discretion).

required_criteria.name: Adverse Authority / Counter-Argument Acknowledgment
required_criteria.description: Must address the opposing party's primary factual or legal contention as supplied in the case notes rather than presenting a one-sided summary.

prohibited_criteria.name: Unanchored Case Citations (Hallucination Gate)
prohibited_criteria.description: Must NEVER cite any case name, reporter volume, or statutory provision that was not explicitly provided in the user's verified authority packet, unless flagged with a '[VERIFY CITATION Needed]' placeholder.
violation_examples: Under well-settled Second Circuit precedent... (without supplied source)

prohibited_criteria.name: Overstated Record Facts or Speculative Inference
prohibited_criteria.description: Must not upgrade disputed allegations into established facts or use absolute modifiers ('undisputedly,' 'conclusively') unless supported verbatim by the record.
